title: Housing Project Delays & Oversight
meeting_type: Austin Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC) Board of Directors AHFC Meeting
summary:
*   Several housing finance items were discussed, with a focus on funding for local housing projects.
*   Four specific housing projects (items 3, 4, 5, 6) were postponed again due to concerns about transparency and financial oversight.
*   These projects had already been delayed for multiple months.
*   Six other housing-related items (1, 2, 7, 8, 9, 10) were approved without controversy.
